title: Discharge Planning Guidance: Readmission Reserve on Lapsed Facility Authorizations in Referrals and Authorizations
content:
A readmission reserve is kept from the days a lapsed Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select releases under **Referrals and Authorizations**, because a patient admitted again within the type's readmission window (the days within which an admission must follow a discharge) needs no new qualifying hospital stay.

## The readmission window

| Authorization type | Readmission window |
|---|---|
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | 30 days |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | 0 days |

(The window figure of every other authorization type is 0 days.)

## Records read

- The facility line: the facility claim line most recently posted under the authorization; its last covered day is its service date plus its covered inpatient days, less one day.
- The days passed: counted from the day after the facility line's last covered day to today.
- Home health visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines dated in the last month.

## Rule

1. Where no more than the readmission window has passed from the day after the facility line's last covered day to today, and home health visits of the patient are dated in the last month, **1 day** is reserved, or the days left if fewer.
2. Where that window has not passed and no home health visit is dated in the last month (no home care picked the patient up), **half of the days left, rounded down**, is reserved.
3. Otherwise nothing is reserved.

The reserve is kept back from the days released.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; skilled nursing facility line whose last covered day is 10 June, so the count starts on 11 June)

| Today | Days passed | Within the 30-day window |
|---|---|---|
| 11 July | 30 | yes |
| 12 July | 31 | no; nothing is reserved |

For an inpatient mental health line with the same last covered day, the 0-day window is met only while no day has passed from 11 June.

## Reserve cases (hypothetical, window met)

| Days left | Home health visits dated in the last month | Reserved |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | yes | 1 |
| 9 | no | 4 (half of 9 is 4.5, rounded down) |
| 0 | yes | 0 (the days left are fewer than 1) |
